Rule.name: IDX Integrity Checker
Rule.Description: A rule to check the integrity of IDX / Ordered Collection relationships in IdentityIQ. This can be run in Task context (IIQ 6.3+) or in IIQ Console context for older versions of IdentityIQ. The goal is for this tool to report in any IDX issues found on a system and to be able to repair those issues when they are found.

Argument.name: log
Argument.Description: The log object associated with the SailPointContext.

Argument.name: context
Argument.Description: A sailpoint.api.SailPointContext object that can be used to query the database if necessary.
